The containment audit covers only study queue, stats helpers, library, and navigation (evidence/containment-audit.txt:26) — the Progress page is absent. My trusted auto-memory records that getProgressPageData (activityDays + lifetimeStats) is NOT flag-aware and leaks notes-derived aggregate data, deferred 'revisit before Chunk 7' — this IS Chunk 7. So a known, unremediated containment leak exists on the Progress page, meaning revoked/unflagged users still see notes-derived aggregate data, violating criteria 1 and 2.

Criterion 3 permits enabling hasNotesAccess only AFTER criteria 1-2 are fully evidenced. The executor already executed scripts/ops/enable-notes-cohort.js and set hasNotesAccess=true for the cohort (report; diff.patch:19-28) despite the Progress-page surface never being verified. External exposure has already been performed with a known open containment gap — a production-impacting action taken with the hard precondition unmet.

The cohort script writes to Clerk user publicMetadata (an entitlement/auth-adjacent flag) and reads/writes the sacred users surface; scanner flagged P1A sacred_table_reference and auth_clerk_content (scanner_report.json:9-47). DEC-N30 pre-approves enabling the named cohort, but the change targets placeholder IDs ('user_cohort_member_1..3', diff.patch:13-17) which cannot be confirmed as the named DEC-N30 users from this pack.
